### Jehu Anointed King-of Israel
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jehu-anointed-king-of-israel
Passage: 2 Kings 9:1–13
Points:
- Enduring the wait for God to judge evil and make things right is difficult for believers.
- The faithful in Israel had waited through multiple reigns for God to avenge the murdered prophets and Naboth.
- Elisha fulfilled God's ancient word to Elijah by commissioning a young prophet to secretly anoint Jehu.
- Jehu was publicly acclaimed king by his fellow commanders to carry out divine judgment against Ahab's dynasty.
- Apparent delays in the fulfillment of God's promises are not denials; His kingdom will surely prevail.

### Bible Pathway - May 4
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-4-2013.html
Passage: 2 Kings 9:7
Points:
- The young prophet faced danger and anxiety in delivering God's grave message to the army commanders.
- Jehu bore the serious weight of a mission that risked execution for treason against the throne.
- The impending destruction of Ahab's house was divine retribution for shedding innocent blood, not personal vengeance.
- While God's justice inevitably prevails, His heart is always to offer mercy and forgiveness before judgment falls.
- Believers are urged to confess their sins now rather than face the consequences of divine wrath.
